name: grapesjs
description_en: Free and Open source Web Builder Framework. Next generation tool for building templates without coding
readme_excerpt: GrapesJS > If you looking to embed the Studio editor in your application, we now offer the Studio SDK, a ready-to-use visual builder that's easy to embed in external applications, with GrapesJS team support included. GrapesJS is a free and open source Web Builder Framework which helps building HTML templates, faster and easily, to be delivered in sites, newsletters or mobile apps.
